name: Main Site Connection Contract
principle: 主站負責前端顯示與 AI provider 調用；後端知識庫只提供真實史料包、發音音檔、引用/去重/敏感內容/禁止關聯/發布前檢查。

required_main_site_env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_KB_API_URL
required_main_site_env.description: 主站瀏覽器可呼叫的知識庫公開 API base URL。只用於 public endpoints。

required_main_site_env.name: PINUYUMAYAN_KB_API_URL
required_main_site_env.description: 主站 server route 呼叫 internal API 的 base URL。

required_main_site_env.name: PINUYUMAYAN_MAIN_SITE_CLIENT_ID
required_main_site_env.description: 主站在知識庫註冊的 client id。

required_main_site_env.name: PINUYUMAYAN_MAIN_SITE_API_KEY
required_main_site_env.description: 主站呼叫 internal API 的 shared secret。不可放入瀏覽器。

required_main_site_env.name: PINUYUMAYAN_HMAC_SECRET
required_main_site_env.description: internal API HMAC 簽章密鑰。可與 API key 分開輪替。

required_main_site_env.name: PINUYUMAYAN_HMAC_ENABLED
required_main_site_env.description: 正式站建議啟用 HMAC + nonce 防重放。

required_main_site_env.name: AI_PROVIDER
required_main_site_env.description: 主站 server-side AI composer 使用的 provider。

required_main_site_env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
required_main_site_env.description: OpenAI provider key；只放主站 server runtime。

required_main_site_env.name: KIMI_API_KEY
required_main_site_env.description: Kimi provider key；只放主站 server runtime。

required_main_site_env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
required_main_site_env.description: 主站正式網址，用於 callback、canonical、OG 與審核連結。

forbidden_relation_rule: Beinan/Peinan archaeological site terms must never become Pinuyumayan/Puyuma cultural source packets, tags, synonyms, or related content.
article_flow: Main site server route resolves source packets from knowledge backend
Main site server route calls OpenAI/Kimi/local provider
Draft is sent back to knowledge backend for validation
Backend checks citations, duplicate fingerprint, forbidden relations, sensitivity and license
